name: Peter Fraser
story: Peter Fraser appears on the December 2008 NZEUG committee list, documenting his participation in the GIS user community.

Peter Fraser asked GISList for clarification about its administration and said he knew of no handover to the user group. A message dated 29 March 2007 was addressed to the “GIS User List” at gislist [at] gis-list.gisuser.co.nz. By 2008 the system also used a gislist-owner [at] gis-list.gisuser.co.nz address and automated subscription controls. Practitioners shared jobs, data sources, conference notices and fixes for ArcGIS, Python, LiDAR, GPS and NZMG-to-NZTM migration.
